resolution.question: Priya needs to move her Thursday dental cleaning because of a work trip. Will she and the Maple Row Dental front desk agree on a new slot by Wednesday noon?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Priya and the Maple Row Dental front desk have agreed on a specific new appointment slot before 2026-08-12T12:00:00-04:00. Resolve NO if no such agreement is reached by that time.
